meta.name: IFC Class Browser (subset)
meta.note: A subset of IFC4X3_ADD2 covering the classes used by the A2Heritage data library. Entity names, supertypes and abstract/concrete markings are taken from the buildingSMART IFC4X3_ADD2 lexicon.

nodes.label: IfcRoot
nodes.description: Root for most persistent IFC entities (GlobalId, OwnerHistory, Name, Description).

nodes.label: IfcObjectDefinition
nodes.description: Generalisation of any semantically treated thing: individual occurrences (IfcObject) and the types they share (IfcTypeObject).

nodes.label: IfcObject
nodes.description: An individual occurrence of something in the project, as built or as planned.

nodes.label: IfcProduct
nodes.description: An object with a physical or spatial location in the project.

nodes.label: IfcProcess
nodes.description: Something that occurs over time. Used by this library for conservation and maintenance activities.

nodes.label: IfcEvent
nodes.description: A process triggered at a point in time; the counterpart of CIDOC-CRM E5 Event in the decay analysis.

nodes.label: IfcProcedure
nodes.description: A logical sequence of work, independent of any schedule.

nodes.label: IfcTask
nodes.description: An identified, schedulable unit of work. Used for planned and suggested interventions.

nodes.label: IfcSpatialElement
nodes.description: A region of space, however it is delimited.

nodes.label: IfcSpatialStructureElement
nodes.description: An element of the project's spatial hierarchy: site, facility, storey or space.

nodes.label: IfcFacility
nodes.description: A built facility. IFC4X3 introduced this as the generalisation of IfcBuilding, so that bridges, roads, railways and marine works sit alongside buildings.

nodes.label: IfcBuilding
nodes.description: A building. Carries this library's HBuilding_DataSheet, HBuilding_MaterialConsistency and HBuilding_HistoricalAnalysis property sets.

nodes.label: IfcFacilityPart
nodes.description: A subdivision of a facility. Its subtypes are domain-specific (bridge, rail, road, marine) and fall outside this subset. Note that IfcBuildingStorey is NOT one of them.

nodes.label: IfcBuildingStorey
nodes.description: A horizontal level within a building. A direct subtype of IfcSpatialStructureElement, not of IfcFacilityPart.

nodes.label: IfcSite
nodes.description: The area of land on which the project is situated.

nodes.label: IfcSpace
nodes.description: A bounded volume. This library tailors servant and served spaces, and vaulted room/bay spaces, for heritage assets.

nodes.label: IfcSpatialZone
nodes.description: A non-hierarchical spatial region, for zones that cut across the spatial structure.

nodes.label: IfcElement
nodes.description: A physically existing constituent of a construction work.

nodes.label: IfcBuiltElement
nodes.description: A physical construction element. Renamed from IfcBuildingElement in IFC4X3; the older name no longer exists in the schema.

nodes.label: IfcBeam
nodes.description: Horizontal or inclined structural member that carries loads primarily by bending.

nodes.label: IfcColumn
nodes.description: Vertical structural member that transmits loads to a foundation.

nodes.label: IfcMember
nodes.description: A structural member with no more specialised classification. Used by this library's template for vault keystones.

nodes.label: IfcRoof
nodes.description: Construction element that protects the building from weather at the top.

nodes.label: IfcSlab
nodes.description: Horizontal construction element (floor, roof slab, landing). This library uses IfcSlabType to represent the intrados of a vault net.

nodes.label: IfcWall
nodes.description: Vertical construction element that bounds or subdivides spaces. Brick and rubble masonry types are included in the library.

nodes.label: IfcElementAssembly
nodes.description: An assembly of elements acting as a whole. Used by this library for vault perimetral arches, ribs and tiercerons.

nodes.label: IfcFeatureElement
nodes.description: A modification applied to an element, rather than an element in its own right.

nodes.label: IfcSurfaceFeature
nodes.description: A feature applied to the surface of an element. With PredefinedType USERDEFINED, this library uses it to represent decay-analysed surfaces carrying the Decay - Report property set.

nodes.label: IfcTypeObject
nodes.description: The common definition shared by a set of occurrences. This library's property sets are type-driven, so this is the branch they bind to.

nodes.label: IfcTypeProduct
nodes.description: A type with a geometric representation, shared by all its occurrences.

nodes.label: IfcElementType
nodes.description: The type definition of an element occurrence. Note that IfcTypeElement is not a valid IFC entity name; this is the correct one.

nodes.label: IfcBuiltElementType
nodes.description: The type definition of a built element.

nodes.label: IfcColumnType
nodes.description: Type definition for columns. The project template includes a Corinthian column type classified against the MIDAS Heritage dictionary.

nodes.label: IfcMemberType
nodes.description: Type definition for members. The project template includes a vault keystone type.

nodes.label: IfcSlabType
nodes.description: Type definition for slabs. Used to represent the intrados of a vault net; carries the BElement_VaultNet property set template.

nodes.label: IfcWallType
nodes.description: Type definition for walls. The project template includes brick masonry and rubble masonry types.

nodes.label: IfcSpatialElementType
nodes.description: The type definition of a spatial element.

nodes.label: IfcSpatialStructureElementType
nodes.description: The type definition of a spatial structure element.

nodes.label: IfcSpaceType
nodes.description: Type definition for spaces. Carries this library's FM_ServantSpace and FM_ServedSpace templates, plus the vaulted room/bay type.

nodes.label: IfcPropertyDefinition
nodes.description: Superclass for property-related definitions: property sets, quantity sets, and the templates that declare them.

nodes.label: IfcPropertySetDefinition
nodes.description: A container of properties attached to an object or a type.

nodes.label: IfcPreDefinedPropertySet
nodes.description: A property set whose properties are fixed by the schema. Note the capital D in PreDefined — IfcPredefinedPropertySet is not a valid entity name.

nodes.label: IfcPropertySet
nodes.description: A user-defined container of properties. Applying this library's templates in an authoring tool produces instances of this entity.

nodes.label: IfcQuantitySet
nodes.description: A container of physical quantities derived from an object's geometry.

nodes.label: IfcPropertyTemplateDefinition
nodes.description: Superclass for the templates that declare the shape of property sets. This is the mechanism the A2Heritage library is built on.

nodes.label: IfcPropertySetTemplate
nodes.description: Declares a property set: its name, the entities it applies to, and the property templates it contains. Each file in propertysets-ifc-4x3/ is a collection of these.

nodes.label: IfcPropertyTemplate
nodes.description: Declares a single property within a property set template.

nodes.label: IfcSimplePropertyTemplate
nodes.description: Declares one property: name, template type (single value, enumerated value, and so on), measure type, and enumerators where applicable.

nodes.label: IfcComplexPropertyTemplate
nodes.description: Declares a property that groups other property templates.

nodes.label: IfcRelationship
nodes.description: Superclass for IFC relationship entities: decomposition, assignment, association and connectivity.
